## Review checklist (REVIEW.md)

- [ ] The question is about the format, structure, integrity or rendering of the file, never about what its content means or says.
- [ ] No threshold families: one canonical threshold per question, never a series of the same question at several thresholds.
- [ ] The code answers exactly the stated question, nothing more, nothing else.
- [ ] `one` and `zero` are unambiguous.
- [ ] Fixtures are synthetic, generated by the tests; no real document.
- [ ] Dependencies are pinned and reviewed.
- [ ] A changed `question`, `one` or `zero` is a new major version.

### Protocol 2 only (`inputs`, `detail`)

- [ ] No value hard-coded in the code: a content search goes only through an `inputs` slot; class detectors are allowed.
- [ ] Each input has the narrowest `kind` and the smallest `max_bytes` the question needs.
- [ ] No threshold families through inputs: no number input compared against the file.
- [ ] Inputs are read only through `sdk.Inputs()` and used only for the stated question.
- [ ] No typed value ever leaves the plugin: not on stdout or stderr, in an error, a panic, a log or the detail, not even partly.
- [ ] `detail` is justified, holds only what the human needs to act, stays under 4 KiB, never echoes a typed value.
- [ ] A changed input (`name`, `kind`, `max_bytes`) or `detail` is a new major version.
